# FG-INT-0022

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 502 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`portal-widgets`](../../ops/runbooks/portal-widgets.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_refused_news_post_is_retried` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ポータルへのお知らせの送信が 1 回失敗しました。自動で再試行します。
- en: One attempt to send news to the portal failed. It will be retried automatically.
- id: Satu percobaan mengirim berita ke portal gagal. Akan dicoba ulang secara otomatis.

## 原因 (cause)

One attempt of the job `portal.news_send` (ADR-0036) did not end with 202: the portal answered another status (`reason=status`, with `status`; 401 / 403 also drop the cached service token), a redirect (`redirect`, never followed), or the connection failed (`connect`, `timeout`, `tls`, `request`), or the service token could not be obtained (`reason=service_token`, after FG-INT-0024). The news row stays `pending` with `attempts`, `last_error_code` and `last_status`; the job queue retries after its backoff (10 s doubling, at most 1 h) up to `portal.max_attempts` runs. Nobody is waiting on it: info.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.portal.news_attempt_failed` carries `news_id`, `source_id`, `attempt`, `max_attempts`, `status` (or none) and `reason`, never the token, the body or the audience. On the database (read-only): the `pending` rows of forge.portal_news, newest first, with attempts, last_error_code and last_status.

## 対処 (fix)

Usually nothing: a portal that is briefly down catches up. If every attempt fails, follow runbook portal-widgets (portal.registry_url, the CA in portal.ca_file, NEWS_SENDER_CLIENTS on the portal listing gitstation).
